visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with light-colored braided hair, wearing a black coat and a pink floral scarf, stands on a train platform and waves enthusiastically. Behind her is a red and white passenger train with 'LNER' branding. A man in a blue cap walks past in the background. (2) The scene cuts to the interior of a train carriage with bright white lighting. A male staff member in a professional uniform vest serves a package to the woman, who smiles and looks toward the camera. (3) A close-up view shows a table with a blue bag of 'Fairfields Farm' chips, a plastic-wrapped 'Roast Chicken, Gravy and Stuffing' bun, and a small dessert cup labeled 'LNER Salted Caramel Pot'. The woman holds the dessert cup and points to it while making facial expressions indicating curiosity. (4) The woman uses a small spoon to eat from the dessert cup. She looks around the cabin and then back at the camera while chewing. The background shows a train window with motion-blurred green landscapes passing by. (5) The setting shifts to a supermarket aisle. The woman is wearing a floral dress and a headband, pointing her finger upwards while speaking to an off-screen person.
